title: Why the Solar System Is Flat
endCardRationale: Seamless loop back to frame 1; ghosted atom shells return in the final 0.6 s.

question.text: Why do all the planets orbit the Sun in a flat plane instead of crisscrossing in 3D like electrons around an atom?
question.pinnedComment: Oort Cloud comets still come from every direction — why didn't they flatten?
